title: common
description: Shared scalar definitions for the row-file schemas. Each mirrors a CHECK constraint in schemas/schema.sql; the grammars are docs/data-model.md §3.2.

slug.description: chip_id, system_id, project_id, implementation_id and every lookup key except license_id.

identifier.description: As slug, but underscores are also separators. Used only by implementation_kind.kind_id, whose literals Appendix B hardcodes.

spdxId.description: SPDX short identifier, or the literal `custom`.

mameShortname.description: MAME's own machine shortname grammar, verbatim.

mameTag.description: A MAME chip tag with any leading colon stripped, or the reserved `:device` used for tagless device_ref rows.

sourcefile.description: MAME driver source path, e.g. `sega/system16a.cpp`. Hyphens occur in real MAME paths (`konami/nwk-tr.cpp`, `sega/315-6154.cpp`); a segment may not begin the path with one.

repoPath.description: Repository-relative path: slash-separated segments of [A-Za-z0-9._+-], no leading or trailing slash, no empty segment.

url.description: Absolute http or https URI with no whitespace.

text.description: Free text that must not be blank; mirrors CHECK (trim(x) <> '').

flag.description: SQLite has no boolean type under STRICT; 0 or 1.
